notes.f1: Not recovered at all. No John William Spriggs anywhere in the final tree, and no father relationship to Reuben Spencer Spriggs. The run never named a parent or claimed a connection to Reuben. It did not eliminate the one candidate household it found. log_011 reads the 1910 Fred Sprigg household of Albert Township, Benson County -- seven indexed persons, Reuben absent -- but leaves the alternative open: "this household is not the parents-of-subject record, OR Reuben had died or was away before 1910". log_012 then finds the Fred E Spriggs household in the 1915 North Dakota state census and calls it "almost certainly the same family", and log_013 records that the image must be transcribed to see whether Reuben, about sixteen in 1915, is a household member the index did not capture. The household was set aside in 1910 and reopened in 1915, not eliminated. The larger miss is jurisdictional. All nine plan items carry jurisdiction "Benson County, North Dakota", and every census search in the log is restricted to North Dakota (log_001-log_008, log_010, log_012). But the starting tree, which the final tree leaves unchanged, already places Reuben at Belle Prairie Township, Beadle County, SOUTH Dakota in 1910 and carries a South Dakota 1915 state census source. The run never searched the state its own tree pointed at, so it could not have reached the household this finding expects.
notes.f2: Not recovered at all. No Charlotte Marie Westby in the final tree and no mother relationship. The only adult woman present is Nora Alvina Satter, Reuben's wife, who was already in the starting tree. As with f1 the run made no claim about a parent before it ended.
